parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear is invalid; use setExpression for persistent state or clearing.

Display.doc: Perform one eye expression, awaiting its transition and return to the current base expression. Each call is a fresh performance. Does not change captions or speech.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: clear, smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear resets the base to neutral.

Display.doc: Set the persistent base eye expression until replaced, cleared or reset on new user speech. Completes on state acceptance, not animation completion. Repeating the same emotion is idempotent.

Robot.doc: Perform the requested finite gesture using motors1–5, starting and ending at their home; never command or wait for the gripper. Accept optional native speed1–1400 and acceleration1–254. Stable arrival advances immediately. Stable off-target positions, send errors and missing feedback end only affected atomic steps and are collected in the final report; subsequent composition steps and Channel actions continue. Unavailable-device steps fail without blind writes, queries or replay. Explicit cancellation stops remaining work. Use only on user request with a connected arm and clear space.

function.name: runtimeInfo
function.description: Read the fixed local runtime configuration description. This is not a live health or model-readiness probe.

function.name: Camera.open
function.description: Enable foreground camera preview and vision processing. Requires camera permission and an available camera; completion confirms capture, not pose-model readiness.

function.name: Camera.close
function.description: Disable camera preview and vision processing, and wait for capture and vision cleanup.

function.name: Camera.flip
function.description: Switch the enabled foreground camera between front and rear lenses. Fails if disabled, busy or unavailable.

function.name: History.list
function.description: List current and archived conversations, current first then newest archives. Returns paged JSON metadata with IDs and explicitly truncated title/input previews. Start at offset 0; use nextOffset for more.

offset.description: Decimal integer from 0 through 64, encoded as a string.

limit.description: Decimal integer from 1 through 5, encoded as a string.

function.name: History.read
function.description: Read a conversation by an ID returned by History.list. Turns are oldest first. Returns paged JSON with bounded user/response previews and truncation flags, not complete text; never replays behavior. Start at offset 0.

offset.description: Decimal integer from 0 through 256, encoded as a string.

limit.description: Decimal integer from 1 through 2, encoded as a string.

function.name: ModelResources.snapshot
function.description: Read current shared model resource inventory, installed groups and progress. Does not download, remove or switch a model.

function.name: Provider.readSettings
function.description: Read confirmed cloud-enabled status and selected cloud model. Contains no URL/key. Does not probe provider availability or change configuration.

function.name: App.openPage
function.description: Open an existing app page through the same registered navigation function as a user tap. Completion confirms route commitment.

function.name: Bluetooth.readStatus
function.description: Read current Bluetooth power/connection and discovered device IDs. Does not scan or move a robot.

function.name: Bluetooth.control
function.description: Submit an explicit Bluetooth connection/discovery command. Accepted is not connected or physically completed. Read status to confirm actual state.

function.name: App.readEnvironment
function.description: Read latest sequenced scene, navigation and device capability facts admitted by the root Agent. Facts are observations, not proof of physical completion.

function.name: ModelResources.download
function.description: Admit a model download using an explicit source. Admission does not mean installed; read the shared inventory for progress.

function.name: ModelResources.cancel
function.description: Cancel and join an admitted model transfer. Failure is returned without replay.
